fitnessSpec.hiking: Moderate-to-strong hiking fitness for a roughly 6-mile round trip from the Snow Lake trailhead with sustained elevation gain plus off-trail talus/gully travel above Snow Lake
fitnessSpec.packWeight: Light day pack (day-trip; no overnight or glacier gear needed) - water, layers, helmet recommended for the rockfall-prone gully

partner_requirements.approachTime: Roughly 2-3 hours from the Snow Lake trailhead to the base of the summit block (estimate)
requiredSkills: Comfortable making a short low-5th-class move to the true summit (roped or unroped per party preference)
Loose-rock/rockfall awareness and spacing technique in the talus gully
Basic route-finding off-trail from Snow Lake into the Unicorn Creek bowl
Turnaround discipline for afternoon thunderstorms on an exposed summit block
partner_requirements.experienceLevel: Intermediate scrambler - needs prior experience on exposed Class 3-4 terrain and should be comfortable unroped (or with a quick handline) on a short low-5th-class move to tag the summit block; not a beginner objective given the loose rock and exposure
